title: Public Health Informatics II
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Public Health Informatics II Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to apply the fundamental principles of public health to health informatics.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to use statistical software to analyze and effectively apply descriptive and inferential statistics for each level of data.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to apply appropriate statistical techniques to analyze, interpret, and present behavioral and social sciences research.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to assess how information systems support public health practice, programs, and health policies.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to use spreadsheets and database management systems to create reports to support health equity in public health decision making.

notes: The catalog prints codes without a space (e.g., PBHSB20); these are the closed-list courses PBHS B20, PBHS B23, PBHS B26, PSYC B5 and COMP B5, so none are marked as catalog additions.
Total of 16 units is stated both in the description ('five course 16 credit certificate') and in the Core Courses heading '(Total 16)'.
Each printed outcome begins with 'Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to...' as part of the outcome text itself; it is kept verbatim.
